In honor of your stout heart,
I will give you this.{VAR BE01}

{VAR 0100 0000} received
the Freeze Badge from Brycen!{VAR BE01}

A move that always results in
a critical hit: Frost Breath.

Only those who are weak need to
flaunt their strength.
Please take this Fresh Water!{VAR BE01}

Ice can be melted with Fire
or shattered with Fighting.{VAR BE01}
Or you might want to smash it
into dust with Rock or Steel.

From Brycen, I've learned how to
say more with fewer words.
